definition: Re-executed: a presentation lost to a restoration failure uses its re-execution when it was restored; when it failed restoration again it is LEFT OUT of the denominator, and in a paired contrast a presentation out in either arm leaves both (the A36 rule). Row-wise: task R's rows (R/<ns>/score*.noexcl.jsonl; A6 / V / G: their `no-exclusion` rows), then the rescue passes, with the adjusted estimator (A36.flagged drops, adjusted.without_flagged). Estimators (by import, unchanged): rates adjusted.tables; K1 paired paired.paired (95 %, B = 20000, seed 20261010); K1 Holm analyze.holm_family with drop_flag (B = 9999, as the A36 block of test-v1/analysis.json); K2, K3 k23_analyze.kitchen_cr2 and held-out mean pooled_result (nominal 96.5 % CR2); three-kitchen mean: equal weights, kitchen-stratified family bootstrap.
